comment: Per-feed data mode: live | fixture | synthetic. Synthetic values are always badged 'emulated' in evidence and UI.

warnings_fr.note: official data.gouv BMS mirror, synced daily (~24h max lag, disclosed in coverage_note)

warnings_uk.note: Met Office shipping-forecast print page (no API exists); gale warnings between issues invisible until next forecast

warnings_us.note: NWS api.weather.gov active alerts per marine zone (official structured API); merged for routes with us_zones

tides.note: per route: NOAA CO-OPS official predictions (US) or CMEMS IBI 15-min SSH (Channel); degrades to synthetic harmonics on fetch failure

observations.note: NDBC realtime2 (GTS mirror of Met Office Channel buoys; native NDBC/C-MAN for US); hourly, past ~45 days only — future windows report not_independently_observed
